blocks.text: This article provides instructions on deploying Basic authentication for your organization. Basic authentication can be deployed for user enrollment and authenticating traffic.
To deploy Basic authentication for user enrollment:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet Authentication Settings.
On the Default Settings tab, ensure that Hosted DB is selected for User Repository Type and Form-Based is selected for Authentication Type.
Create and activate a user in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Use the following API POST command to enroll users:
Enter the <userId> and <password> for the configured user.
To learn more, see the Internet & SaaS (ZIA) API documentation.
Save and activate your changes. This computes an HA1 value and propagates it across the Zscaler service.

blocks.text: To deploy Basic authentication for traffic:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet Authentication Settings.
On the Default Settings tab, ensure that Hosted DB is selected for User Repository Type and Form-Based is selected for Authentication Type.
Configure a location using your desired forwarding proxy method. Make sure to select Enforce Authentication and Enable Basic Authentication.
If you enable Enforce Surrogate IP for Known Browsers, you must select Cookie and Proxy for Supported Authentication Methods for IP surrogacy to work.
